normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Six passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Gulf views- Wrap-around terraces on both the main floor and the top floor- Private gated beach access *Please note that the beach is NOT private, just the access point- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day- Elevator- 7 Adult bikes- 2 blocks from the beach- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- Short bike ride to SeasideDETAILS: 4 Shore is a magnificent 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home on the Gulf Coast that sleeps 20. More than 4,000 square feet of living space provides an expansive great room, 2 wraparound terraces, a private pool, in-home elevator, and gorgeous views. Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, revel in the tranquil atmosphere of this community and visit white sandy beaches—only 2 blocks away!This soaring 3-story retreat is great for spending quality time together. On the ground-floor patio, soak up the sun on loungers, swim in the covered pool, and dine alfresco with the BBQ grill—there's even a 65" TV for entertainment. After the beach, the outdoor shower is great for rinsing off before accessing the elevator.The first floor provides comfort with 3 incredible bedrooms, each with a private spa-like bathroom. There is a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 2 guest bedrooms—one with a king bed and the other a queen—both with balcony access.Designed with a sophisticated beach aesthetic, this home's second floor showcases breathtaking views through expansive windows. A welcoming great room blends the living, dining, and kitchen areas for seamless conversation. A posh living area offers luxe yet laid-back furniture to socialize and enjoy a movie, especially with a 60" TV. Surrounding this inviting spot are classic shiplap walls and gorgeous artwork, while overhead, natural wood beams accent the high ceilings. The formal dining space seats 10, while the breakfast bar seats 4 more. Prep Sunday brunch or gather snacks for the beach in this chef-worthy kitchen, with pristine white cabinetry and high-end appliances. Access the wraparound terrace off the great room to enjoy gentle sea breezes and stunning sunsets. The guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom offers a convenient place to retire.The third floor boasts 3 guest bedrooms—2 king beds and 1 queen bed—each with a private bathroom and refreshing shower. Two bedrooms enjoy wraparound terrace access and beautiful views of the Gulf of Mexico.As an exquisite new 30A hideaway, 4 Shore will surely be a family favorite. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes—it's an easy trip to Seaside for entertainment. When it's time to hit the beach, slip on some flip-flops and stroll across the street to this home's private gated beach access. Book this Seagrove oasis today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 20):SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full/Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Please note there is active construction in the surrounding area. Completion time is TBD.

More than 4,000 square feet of living space provides an expansive great room, 2 wraparound terraces, a private pool, in-home elevator, and gorgeous views. Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, revel in the tranquil atmosphere of this community and visit white sandy beaches—only 2 blocks away! This soaring 3-story retreat is great for spending quality time together. On the ground-floor patio, soak up the sun on loungers, swim in the covered pool, and dine alfresco with the BBQ grill—there's even a 65" TV for entertainment. After the beach, the outdoor shower is great for rinsing off before accessing the elevator. The first floor provides comfort with 3 incredible bedrooms, each with a private spa-like bathroom. There is a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 2 guest bedrooms—one with a king bed and the other a queen—both with balcony access. Designed with a sophisticated beach aesthetic, this home's second floor showcases breathtaking views through expansive windows. A welcoming great room blends the living, dining, and kitchen areas for seamless conversation. A posh living area offers luxe yet laid-back furniture to socialize and enjoy a movie, especially with a 60" TV. Surrounding this inviting spot are classic shiplap walls and gorgeous artwork, while overhead, natural wood beams accent the high ceilings. The formal dining space seats 10, while the breakfast bar seats 4 more. Prep Sunday brunch or gather snacks for the beach in this chef-worthy kitchen, with pristine white cabinetry and high-end appliances. Access the wraparound terrace off the great room to enjoy gentle sea breezes and stunning sunsets. The guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom offers a convenient place to retire. The third floor boasts 3 guest bedrooms—2 king beds and 1 queen bed—each with a private bathroom and refreshing shower. Two bedrooms enjoy wraparound terrace access and beautiful views of the Gulf of Mexico. As an exquisite new 30A hideaway, 4 Shore will surely be a family favorite. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes—it's an easy trip to Seaside for entertainment. When it's time to hit the beach, slip on some flip-flops and stroll across the street to this home's private gated beach access. Book this Seagrove oasis today!
